title: Black Light FTL Family Encounter-Time Registry

designIntentSource.title: The different lightspeed methods
designIntentSource.scope: Family-specific route error, gravitational sensitivity, predictive sensing and emergency de-transit require the physical environment to be evaluated at the epochs that the selected family actually commits to or encounters each route state.

CONTINUOUS_PROJECTED_PROGRESS.rule: Evaluate each physical route sample at t(s)=t0+sL/v_progress when the family/controller provides a defensible projected-progress representation.
CONTINUOUS_PROJECTED_PROGRESS.safeguard: v_progress is a route/control parameter. For true-FTL families it is not automatically local real-space hull velocity.

PRECOMMIT_ENDPOINT.rule: Evaluate commitment and emergence environments at explicit epochs. Do not fabricate intermediate encounter epochs or a local FTL speed.

ANCHORED_PORTAL.rule: Evaluate entry-mouth and exit-mouth physical states at their anchor encounter epochs. The intervening topological connection is not represented as an ordinary-space traversed corridor.

adaptiveRefinementIntegration.rule: Continuous projected-progress samples may be recursively refined when physical metrics, principal tidal eigenvalues, acceleration direction, propagated covariance, source motion relative to range, or encounter-time span exceed versioned numerical tolerances. PRECOMMIT_ENDPOINT and ANCHORED_PORTAL remain endpoint/mouth models and do not receive fabricated corridor samples.

mathematics.retardedGravityCaveat: The current weak-field engineering model evaluates source states at the declared coordinate epoch and is not a full relativistic retarded-field solution. High-beta sources, compact objects, strong fields or precision regimes outside that approximation require a higher-fidelity model.

generatorRules: Select encounter policy from the explicit transit family id; a race or technology basis may not silently choose a family.

Continuous families require a positive projectedProgressMPerS and an explicit progressSemantic; equivalent speed alone is insufficient unless the selected family authority defines it as the route/control progress mapping.
PRECOMMIT_ENDPOINT families require explicit commitment and emergence epochs; missing epochs remain unresolved.
ANCHORED_PORTAL requires entry and exit mouth epochs and preserves anchor provenance.
Every sample propagates every authoritative gravitational source independently to its encounter epoch before evaluating ordinary gravity and curvature.
A failed or out-of-domain source propagation blocks that sample; benign neighboring samples may not average it away.
Continuous encounter samples may be densified only through the adaptive refinement authority; midpoint evidence must be recomputed through this resolver rather than interpolated.
The resulting physical environment is evidence supplied to family certification. It does not itself establish operator-specific boundary state.
canonSafeguards: This registry does not establish that any FTL method is physically realizable.
Encounter-time propagation changes the epoch of physical source evidence; it does not rewrite the historical or species canon of those sources.
Named race, vessel, manufacturer, installation and technology sources outrank this generic timing layer within their documented scope.
A selected family used for simulation does not establish that a named civilization uses that family.
Missing source velocity, covariance, epoch, acceleration, portal-anchor state or model-validity evidence may not be silently replaced by zero.
True-FTL projected progress is an engineering/control representation unless higher authority explicitly identifies it with a local physical velocity.
Fold Jump, Q-Lattice Phase Translation and Phase Displacement may not be assigned fabricated intermediate encounter epochs derived from an invented corridor velocity.
Anchored Wormhole/Gate transit evaluates mouth states and does not imply ordinary-space traversal between mouths.
Ordinary gravity/curvature evidence may not manufacture an exotic family-boundary hazard or silently set that hazard to zero.
Adaptive sampling changes numerical evidence density rather than setting canon or proving convergence.
OUTSIDE_MODEL_VALIDITY is a model-domain refusal, not an extreme finite danger score.
